question: Is the multi-cue rank-two H3 subspace an actual manipulable response variable that transports into weight-predicted L15H5/H1 on sealed v8?

authority.downstream_prediction: The exact weight interface ranks L15H5 first and places L15H1 at percentile 0.887 among known downstream attention readers.

frozen_design.population: The 29 A1 and 31 A2 jointly capable v8 rows.
frozen_design.writer: Exact L8H1 cue-to-subject write, used only to capture the live block11 H3 response.

response_arms.h3_full: Install the complete captured H3 query-response delta into the native base run.
response_arms.h3_rank2: Install only Q Q^T times that delta for the frozen two-task DIM-union basis Q.
response_arms.h3_orthogonal: Install only (I-Q Q^T) times the same delta.

frozen_design.downstream: Capture block15 head outputs and score the joint L15H5/H1 response relative to h3_full, alongside answer/foil recovery.

predictions.pred_a_authority_capability_exact_instru: Authorities, capability, QR orthonormality, attention reconstruction, identity, patch algebra, complete records, and price hold.
predictions.pred_b_full_h3_response_is_material: h3_full is donorward on at least 90% of rows and recovers at least 30% of live-writer behavior in both panels.
predictions.pred_c_rank2_is_behaviorally_sufficient: h3_rank2 retains at least 80% of h3_full signed behavioral recovery with at least 90% donorward rows in both panels.
predictions.pred_d_orthogonal_complement_is_secondar: Absolute h3_orthogonal behavioral recovery is at most 30% of h3_full in both panels.
predictions.pred_e_rank2_transports_to_weight_predic: The rank-two arm retains at least 75% of the full H3-induced joint L15H5/H1 response norm in both panels.

decision: identification if all pass; representation_only if B holds but C/D/E fail; null if full H3 is immaterial; invalid if A fails.
